      • Class edu.cnu.mdi.component.OptionPanel

        class OptionPanel extends JPanel implements Serializable

        • Serialized Fields

          • _background
            Color _background
            Background colour for the panel and all checkboxes, or null to use the default.
          • _columnCount
            int _columnCount
            Number of columns requested by the caller.
          • _columnWidths
            int[] _columnWidths
            Width of each column in pixels, indexed by zero-based column index. Set by OptionPanel.layoutEntries() and consumed by OptionPanel.doLayout().
          • _contentSize
            Dimension _contentSize
            The size required to display all checkboxes, excluding any border insets. Set by OptionPanel.layoutEntries() and consumed by OptionPanel.getPreferredSize().

            Design note – why content size rather than full preferred size:
            Layout is performed once at construction time. If a border is attached after construction (a common pattern when the border is set in a subclass constructor after super() returns), the insets reported by JComponent.getInsets() during layout are zero and therefore cannot be included in a size snapshot. By storing only the border-inset-free content size here, OptionPanel.getPreferredSize() can add the current insets at call time, giving a correct result regardless of when the border is applied.

          • _entries
            List<edu.cnu.mdi.component.OptionPanel.OptionEntry> _entries
            All entries in their original (constructor-supplied) order. Used by OptionPanel.getSelectedOptionLabels() to preserve insertion order.
          • _entryByLabel
            Map<String, edu.cnu.mdi.component.OptionPanel.OptionEntry> _entryByLabel
            Fast lookup from label to entry. Labels are assumed to be unique; if duplicates are present, the later entry silently overwrites the earlier one.
          • _font
            Font _font
            Font applied to all checkbox labels.
          • _foreground
            Color _foreground
            Foreground colour for labels, or null to use the default.
          • _layoutOption
            int _layoutOption
            One of OptionPanel.AS_ORDERED, OptionPanel.ALPHABETICAL, or OptionPanel.MINSIZE.
          • _listener
            OptionPanel.OptionPanelListener _listener
            Delegate notified when any checkbox changes state, or null if no notification is required.
          • _maxRows
            int _maxRows
            Maximum number of rows across all columns. Equal to the number of entries in the tallest column after distribution.
          • _orderedEntries
            List<edu.cnu.mdi.component.OptionPanel.OptionEntry> _orderedEntries
            Entries in the order they should be rendered (possibly reordered from OptionPanel._entries depending on OptionPanel._layoutOption). Set once by OptionPanel.layoutEntries() and used by OptionPanel.doLayout() to position checkboxes with the correct live insets.
          • _rowHeight
            int _rowHeight
            Height of a single row in pixels (font height + OptionPanel.VGAP). Set by OptionPanel.layoutEntries() and consumed by OptionPanel.doLayout().

    • Package edu.cnu.mdi.feedback

      • Class edu.cnu.mdi.feedback.FeedbackPane

        class FeedbackPane extends TextPaneScrollPane implements Serializable

        • Serialized Fields

          • bg
            Color bg
            Background color applied to all text styles.
          • DEFAULT_STYLE
            SimpleAttributeSet DEFAULT_STYLE
            Default style: cyan text, configured background, SansSerif, bold.
          • fontSize
            int fontSize
            Base font size used for the default and color-named styles.
          • SMALL_MONO_STYLE
            SimpleAttributeSet SMALL_MONO_STYLE
            Small monospaced style: cyan text, configured background, Monospaced font, smaller size, bold.
          • styleCache
            Map<String, SimpleAttributeSet> styleCache
            Cache of styles keyed by lower-case X11 color names.

            For example, the key "red" maps to a style that renders red text on the configured background.

            A plain HashMap is used (rather than a concurrent variant) because all paths that read or write this map — FeedbackPane.append(String) and FeedbackPane.updateFeedback(List) — are called exclusively on the Swing Event Dispatch Thread. Mouse-motion events that drive feedback updates are delivered on the EDT, and FeedbackPane.updateFeedback(List) is only invoked from there. A ConcurrentHashMap would add synchronization overhead with no correctness benefit.

          • autoResetOnSliderRelease
            boolean autoResetOnSliderRelease
            If true, the panel automatically requests a reset when the user releases a slider knob (getValueIsAdjusting() == false) while the engine is in an editable state.

            Disabled by default. Enable if you want the demo to reinitialize immediately whenever a slider value changes, without requiring an explicit Reset button press.

            IconSimulationControlPanel basePanel
            Standard media-button panel (play/pause/stop/cancel + progress bar).

            boolean dirty
            True if the slider values have changed since the last reset. Used to decide whether Reset should be enabled. All reads and writes occur on the EDT so no synchronization is needed.
          • host
            ISimulationHost host
            The simulation host this panel is bound to (typically TspDemoView).

      • Class edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspDemoView

        class TspDemoView extends SimulationView implements Serializable

        • Serialized Fields

          • bestTourSnapshot
            int[] bestTourSnapshot
            Cached best tour snapshot used exclusively by the drawing hooks.

            Written by TspDemoView.newBest(double, double) and TspDemoView.onSimulationProgress(SimulationContext, ProgressInfo) on the simulation thread and EDT respectively; read by the before-draw hook on the EDT during each repaint. The volatile modifier ensures the EDT always sees the most recently written array reference. Array contents are not modified after the snapshot is taken (tour.clone()).

          • cityRadiusPx
            int cityRadiusPx
            Radius in pixels for the filled circle drawn at each city.
          • evtPlot
            EvsTPlotPanel evtPlot
            The Energy vs. Temperature scatter plot installed as the right-side diagnostics panel. Receives accepted-move and new-best notifications via IAcceptedMoveListener.
          • model
            TspModel model
            The current TSP model (city positions and river configuration).

            Volatile because it is written on the EDT (during reset) and read on the EDT (during painting). The simulation thread reads it only indirectly through TspAnnealingProblem, which holds its own reference.

          • sim
            SimulatedAnnealingSimulation<TspSolution> sim
            The current SA simulation instance.

            Volatile because it is written on the EDT during reset and read on both the EDT (in drawing and listener callbacks) and the simulation thread (indirectly through the engine).
